Step1.Title: 1. Start of the Round
Step1.Effects: Active effects are resolved automatically (e.g. bleeding, regeneration).

Step2.Title: 2. Character Turns
Step2.Limit: during your turn you may perform a maximum of 1 movement action and 1 attack action

Step3.Title: 3. Reactions
Step3.Intro: Outside your turn you have 1 reaction:

Step4.Title: 4. End of the Round
Step4.End: Once everyone has taken their turn, the round ends.
Step4.NoEnemies: If there are no enemies, combat may end.
Step4.EarlyEnd: Combat may also end earlier if it no longer makes sense to continue.

DelayTurn.DelayText1: At the start of your turn, you may delay your turn to act later in the same round.
DelayTurn.DelayText2: You cannot delay your turn behind an opponent who has already delayed theirs to act after you.
DelayTurn.DelayText3: Unused actions are lost at the end of the round.

VersusTests.VersusText1: A difference of 60 MoS turns a success into a critical success
VersusTests.VersusText2: Ties are won by the attacker
VersusTests.VersusText3: If both sides roll a natural critical success, the lower d100 roll wins, but the result is only a standard success
VersusTests.VersusText4: If the defender does not defend, it counts as a critical failure for the defender

Rerolls.RerollsText1: A roll can only be rerolled once per test, and rerolls cannot be used on a natural critical failure.
Rerolls.RerollsText2: Rerolls that can be used on a natural critical failure may also be used even after a previous reroll.
Rerolls.RerollsText3: The ability to reroll refreshes daily, unless stated otherwise.

Description.move: Move up to a number of hexes equal to Speed. Moving around an enemy always costs 1 hex and may be interrupted by a successful Opportunity Attack. Movement may trigger a Reaction. The final movement may be affected by terrain. When an Opportunity Attack is triggered by movement, the character does not have the right to Defense.
Description.sprint: Run a distance of Speed * 2 hexes. Increases Ranged defense by 15% and reduces Defense by 25%. Maximum running distance is 12 hexes. If an Opportunity Attack is triggered by moving away from an opponent, the character cannot use Defense. Final movement may be affected by terrain
Description.slowMove: Move up to a number of hexes equal to Speed/2, rounded down. Moving around an enemy always costs 1 hex and may be interrupted by a successful Opportunity Attack. Movement may trigger a Reaction. When an Opportunity Attack is triggered by movement, the character has the right to Defense.
Description.disengage: Break free from enemy without provoking an Opportunity Attack and move Speed/2 (rounded down) hexes away from the enemy. This movement cannot be used to move around an enemy or to end adjacent to another enemy.
Description.aim: Increases Hit chance (Ranged and Melee) by +10% for the next attack. The action may be repeated to stack the bonus; a maximum of 4 Aiming stacks can be applied to a target. Special rules apply for bows (see Armory). Aiming can only be performed on a target within range.
Description.improvedAim: Increases Hit chance by +10% for the next attack. The action may be repeated to stack the bonus, up to a maximum of +40%. A target can be aimed at any distance. If the attacker has four Aiming stacks on a target, an attack with a one-handed sword gains Armor Penetration +10 (the off hand must be free or hold a fencing dagger). (Duelist II – A hit reduces Aiming by only one level; a Critical Hit preserves all Aiming stacks. Duelist VII – Melee defense against the aimed target gains +5% per Aiming stack, and costs no Aiming.)
Description.attack: Makes an attack against a target within reach. This action cannot be performed more than once per round, nor combined with another offensive action. When Shooting or Throwing from contact range, it triggers a free Opportunity Attack.
Description.sneakAttack: Attack modification. Damage +1d6. Applies against surprised or undefending targets, or in doctrine-defined situations. For effect upgrades see Armory or Doctrine. Can be applied multiple times per round; however, it can only be applied once per round against the same opponent.
Description.multiAttack: Perform as many attacks as you are capable of. The attacks can be directed at one or multiple targets.
Description.opportunityAttack: An attack triggered by a specific action of an adjacent enemy, most commonly movement, casting, or shooting.
Description.action: Draw a weapon, take something out of a pocket, switch weapons, drink a potion, stand up from the ground, mount a horse, and similar actions. Some actions may provoke an Opportunity Attack. Drinking a potion does not provoke an Opportunity Attack if the potion was “at hand.”
Description.dodge: Alternative form of defense, a Dodge vs Test against the opponent’s Hit. On success, ignores Penetration. Base success threshold is 50.
Description.rest: Restores 5 Stamina. This action can be used multiple times per round.
Description.reload: Reloads a weapon. The number of actions required depends on the Reload type of the weapon.
Description.castSpell: Casts a spell. Cannot be combined with Offensive actions. Casting at contact range may trigger an Opportunity Attack. The required actions and mana cost depend on the spell.
Description.reactionSpell: Casts a spell that can be paid for with a reaction. A Speed Test must be made to determine whether the caster is fast enough; on a failure, the reaction is resolved afterward.
Description.focus: Follows the Casting. Reduces the spell’s Difficulty by 10%. The action may be repeated. The spell’s Difficulty cannot be reduced into positive values. This bonus does not apply to Magical Attack. It does not reduce the penalty for insufficient School level. The spell may be cast immediately after resolving the Focus action.

difficulty.label: Craft difficulty

prone.desc: A prone character attacks and defends at -20% and dodges at -25%. Going prone also drops the character to initiative 1.

dying.label: Dying
dying.desc: Applied at 0 health. A hidden countdown of rounds is rolled when Dying starts and ticks down at the start of every round; when it runs out the character bleeds out unless First Aid stabilises them first.

downed.label: Downed
downed.desc: Applied together with Dying when a character drops to 0 health. The character falls to initiative 1 and loses half of their remaining Mind; if Mind reaches 0 they also become Incapacitated.

bleeding.label: Bleeding
bleeding.desc: Each stack of Bleeding deals 1d4 damage when it is applied and again at the start of every round. Bleeding stacks up to 6 times.

rooted.label: Rooted
rooted.desc: A rooted character has their Speed halved and suffers -15% to attacks, defense and dodge until the effect ends.

fatigue.label: Fatigue
fatigue.desc: Fatigue is counted in degrees and every degree cuts maximum stamina by 5. From degree 2 Speed drops by 1, degree 3 gives -10% on all tests, degree 4 adds disadvantage to every roll, and degree 5 reduces Speed to 1.

corruption.label: Corruption
corruption.desc: A permanent tier read from the Corruption stat. 0-30 is degree 0; 31-60 degree 1 (Magic Attack and Defense +5%); 61-90 degree 2 (+10%, Dark Spell Power +1, the character counts as Corrupted); 91-100 degree 3 (+15%, Dark Spell Power +3, plus vulnerability to Light). At 101 or more an immediate mutation strikes and Corruption drops by 50.

aim.label: Aim
aim.desc: Each Aim action grants +10% to hit against the aimed target, up to 4 stacks. Switching targets burns every stack. Attacking the aimed target spends them all, and attacking anybody else breaks the aim outright. Improved Aim (Duelist I, or Servant of the Sword) keeps the aim intact when you attack somebody else, and adds +10 armour penetration at 4 stacks. Aim reduction (Duelist II, or either Aim-reduction node) costs a single stack on a hit and none on a critical hit, while a miss still costs the lot. Servant of the Sword adds one Aim after a Sneak Attack; Sword Dancer instead costs nothing on a Sneak Attack that lands, and only half the stacks (rounded up) on a miss. Duelist VII turns Aim to defense as well: melee defense against the opponent you are aiming at gains +5% per stack, and defending costs no Aim. Every duellist perk needs the qualifying sword in hand. Counterattack, Retaliatory strike, Cleave, Polearm Cleave, Double Throw and Cunning Strike have no interaction with Aiming at all.

spellPower.label: Spell Power
spellPower.desc: Spell Power (SK) is calculated separately for each magic school and scales what the caster's spells do. Fractions of SK always round down.

bane.label: Bane
bane.desc: A Bane is a chosen category of creature. Against a target of that category the attack gains +5% to hit, +1 critical chance and +1 penetration; the bonuses apply only once the target is confirmed to belong to the category.

desperateEffort.label: Desperate Effort
desperateEffort.desc: A toggle for a single roll: +20% to succeed, critical success threshold +5% and critical failure threshold -5%, and fatigue penalties are ignored for that roll. It costs one degree of Fatigue.

advantage.label: Advantage
advantage.desc: Advantage rolls 2d100 and keeps the better die. Advantage and disadvantage from different sources cancel each other out, so only the net result is rolled.

disadvantage.label: Disadvantage
disadvantage.desc: Disadvantage rolls 2d100 and keeps the worse die. Advantage and disadvantage from different sources cancel each other out, so only the net result is rolled.

deflect.label: Deflect
deflect.desc: A percentage chance rolled automatically on every defense and dodge card. On a success the incoming blow is deflected aside.

precision.label: Precision
precision.desc: A percentage chance rolled when an attack hits. When it procs, that strike becomes eligible for a critical hit.

sustained.label: Sustained
sustained.desc: A spell with a cost per round keeps running as a Channeling effect after the initial cast. A sustained spell rolls its effect again every round, and the caster can drop it at any time by cancelling Channeling.

graveWound.label: Grave Wound
graveWound.desc: Every untreated grave wound applies -5% to all tests. Treating a wound gives 3% of that penalty back, and only proper healing removes the wound itself.

StatInfo.str: Physical power. Each point adds +1 weapon damage in Combat and Throwing (when Strength beats Perception), +3% to hit in Combat, +1 Health and +3% to derived skills. It also helps Intimidation. Dropping to 0 means death.
StatInfo.dex: Agility. Each point adds +3% to melee Defense and to Dodge, and +3% to derived skills. Certain Dexterity thresholds raise Speed. Dropping to 0 means death.
StatInfo.end: Physical resilience. Each point adds +5 Stamina, +2 Toxicity, +2 to +4 Health (by Level) and +1 Shadow Health. It also drives Health regeneration and Toxicity reduction on a Long Rest. Dropping to 0 means death.
StatInfo.int: Intellect. Each point adds +1 Mana Base and +3% to derived skills and Channeling; every two points add +1 Spell Power. Certain thresholds widen the critical range for Magic. Dropping to 0 means death.
StatInfo.wil: Mental resilience. Each point adds +1 Mental Health, +1 Mana Base, +1 Willpower, +1 mental-duel attack and +3% to derived skills. It also helps Persuasion. Dropping to 0 means death.
StatInfo.cha: Social intelligence. Each point adds +1 Inspiration and +3% to derived skills; every two points add +1 Art Power. It improves Persuasion, Deception, Intimidation, Temptation and Insight. Dropping to 0 means death.
StatInfo.per: Awareness. Each point adds +1 weapon damage in Archery and Throwing (when Perception beats Strength), +3% to hit, +1 critical damage and +1 critical penetration. It also sets passive trap detection and herb gathering. Dropping to 0 means death.
StatInfo.spd: Each point adds 1 to movement. A Speed Test (Speed + Initiative + 1d12) sets turn order and decides who acts first on Reactions; it knows no natural critical success or failure. The absolute cap is 6.
StatInfo.lck: Each positive point adds +1% critical success chance on skills and attributes (Faith excluded); each negative point adds +1% critical failure chance. Tested for gambling, lucky finds and dodging accidents.
StatInfo.res: Resolve is only ever tested, and it is one of the most common Tests. It resists fear, panic and madness. Each point of Sinfulness lowers the Test by -1%, or -3% for a chosen Sin. Luck does not improve its criticals.
StatInfo.fth: Piety. Each point adds +1 Miracle Power and +5 Holy Energy. A priest tests Faith to restore Holy Energy, or when begging for divine intervention (usually costing 2 rounds).
StatInfo.sin: The pull of instinct and vice. Each point adds +1% to Temptation. The character picks Sins as weaknesses (Sinfulness 3, 5, 7, …). Each point lowers Resolve Tests tied to a Sin by -1%, or -3% for a chosen weakness.
StatInfo.vis: The character's relative beauty. It improves Persuasion, Deception and Temptation (when higher than Perception), and Intimidation when negative. Visage has no Tests of its own, but can gate certain Temptation Tests.
StatInfo.ini: Initiative only ever applies as a bonus to Speed Tests and is never tested on its own. It has no absolute cap.
StatInfo.health: Set by Race, Traits, Specializations, Strength and Endurance. At 0 the character is Downed and on the Brink of Death; without stabilisation they die, and surviving costs a Grave Wound. A Long Rest restores 10 + Endurance*2.
StatInfo.stamina: Fuel for combat actions. Set by Endurance*5, Athletics*2, Traits and Specializations. Restored by the Catch Breath action. Each Fatigue degree lowers the maximum by 5, and you may restore 50% of the maximum at any time for one degree of Fatigue.
StatInfo.toxicity: How much alcohol and how many potions the body tolerates. Set by Endurance*2, Race, Traits and Specializations. Exceeding the maximum triggers Toxic Shock immediately. Reduction is 5 + Endurance*2 per day.
StatInfo.mana: Fuel for spells. The Mana Base (Race + Traits + Specializations + Intelligence + Will + skill) multiplied by the modifier from Magic Potential or a magic Doctrine. Regeneration is set by the Doctrine.
StatInfo.holyEnergy: Fuel for miracles. Set by the Priest specialization, Faith*5 and priestly oaths. A successful Faith Test fully restores it once per day, at the hour the god demands, and costs one Camping time unit.
StatInfo.bloodPool: The blood reserve the Blood School spends instead of Mana. Blood Transfer is how much Health converts to blood at once, and follows the Blood School rank (5 / 10 / 15 / 25).
StatInfo.mind: Mental Health broadly represents the soul. Set by Will, Specializations and Counter-Mage oaths. It can be burned, reserved or drained; drained points return on a Long Rest (1 + Specializations). At 0 the character falls unconscious.
StatInfo.insanity: Insanity points. Crossing the Madness Threshold (base 4 + Will + Traits) forces a Hard Resolve Test; failing rolls a Flaw and costs five points. Each further point past the threshold raises the difficulty by 10%.
StatInfo.armor: Total damage reduction from worn armor, natural armor and effects. Every damage type keeps its own value, and Vulnerability, Resistance and Immunity are resolved against the attack's damage types.
StatInfo.detection: Passive trap detection, calculated as Perception + Traps skill*2. Finding a trap usually needs 6 to 26. Penalties: dim light -6, darkness -16, hurrying -12.

WeaponInfo.attack: The weapon's bonus to hit. Quality shifts it further: Poor -5%, Expert +3%, Master +5%, Legendary +8%. Holding a weapon in the non-dominant hand costs 10%, and a Heavy weapon one-handed costs 15%.
WeaponInfo.defense: The weapon's bonus to Defense. Each additional opponent defended against in the same round costs -5%, up to a maximum of -20% (Being Outnumbered). It resets at the start of the round.
WeaponInfo.dodge: The weapon's modifier to Dodge. Dodge counts as a Defensive action, so the Outnumbered penalty applies. Brawler weapons take a further -30% to Dodge against armed opponents.
WeaponInfo.critRange: A bonus to the 1d20 that decides the degree of a critical hit. 1-6 is degree 1, 7-12 degree 2, 13-18 degree 3 and 19-20 degree 4. Effects from several sources stack.
WeaponInfo.critChance: The weapon's critical hit chance. The base is 5%, modified further by Luck, skill and Specializations. A successful hit that beats the opponent's Defense by 60 is also a critical hit.
WeaponInfo.critFail: The weapon's critical failure chance. A critical failure on an attack hands the opponent a guaranteed critical Defense.
WeaponInfo.critDefense: The weapon's critical Defense chance. A critical Defense turns a critical hit into an ordinary one, and a stronger critical Defense negates the hit entirely.
WeaponInfo.critDodge: The weapon's critical Dodge chance. Conversely, a critical failure while Dodging leads to a critical hit against you.
WeaponInfo.critPenetration: Extra Penetration on a critical hit. Degrees 0 and 1 add 5 + Perception, degrees 2 and 3 add 10 + Perception, and degree 4 adds 15 + Perception.
WeaponInfo.critDamage: Extra damage on a critical hit. Each point of Perception adds 1, and the higher critical degrees add a further 5 to 20 damage.
WeaponInfo.penetration: The floor below which damage cannot be reduced by Armor. It does not apply to special Armor such as Fire or Magic Armor.
WeaponInfo.breakthrough: Deals damage even through a successful Defense. It does not apply to Dodge or a critical Defense, and the attack itself must not be a failure. It respects Penetration and applies no effects such as Bleeding or Stagger.
WeaponInfo.sneakDamage: Extra damage on a Sneak Attack. Some materials raise it further, for example Obsidium by 2d6 and Dragon Tooth by 1d6 on light weapons.
WeaponInfo.tags: A free-form list of the weapon's properties, for example Long Reach, Quick, Brawler or Magazine. It feeds Specializations and Banes; the note describes each property.
WeaponInfo.finesse: A Refined weapon uses Dexterity instead of Strength or Perception for hitting and damage. It requires the Finesse specialization.
WeaponInfo.twoHandGrip: Light and Medium melee weapons held in two hands gain +1d6 damage. The Rapier, Katar, Dagger, Fencing Dagger and Throwing Knife cannot be held this way.
WeaponInfo.longReach: The weapon's reach is increased by one hex. Effects from several sources stack.
WeaponInfo.sharp: The weapon rolls two dice to cause Bleeding instead of one.
WeaponInfo.thrown: The weapon can be thrown. Attacking a target beyond its effective range costs -20% to Throwing.
WeaponInfo.offhand: The weapon can be held in the off hand. Using a hand other than the dominant one costs 10% to hitting, Defense, Throwing, Archery and Firearms.
WeaponInfo.stagger: The weapon's chance to cause Stagger for two turns. A critical hit of degree 2 or higher adds +100% to that chance.
WeaponInfo.bleed: The weapon's chance to cause Bleeding. The Sharp property rolls two dice instead of one, and a critical hit of degree 2 or higher adds +100%.
WeaponInfo.diceNum: How many dice of base damage the weapon deals. On a hit, damage resolves in a fixed order: Armor first, then Penetration, special Armor, percentage adjustments, and finally Temporary Health and Health.
WeaponInfo.dieSize: The size of the weapon's base damage dice. Light and Medium melee weapons held in two hands gain a further +1d6.
WeaponInfo.rollMod: A flat damage adjustment on top of the dice. A weapon's material usually adds its bonus here, for example Red Steel +2d4 or Eldarin +3d4.
WeaponInfo.quality: Weapon quality: Poor -5% to hitting and Defense, Normal nothing, Expert +3%, Master +5% and Precision +5%, Legendary +8%, Precision +10% and critical hit +3%. The Sling, Lance and Improvised Weapon cannot exceed Normal quality.
WeaponInfo.weaponClass: The weapon's class decides which Specializations and Doctrine actions it can be used with. Failing a weapon's attribute or training requirement costs 10% to success, and that penalty stacks.
WeaponInfo.weaponType: The weapon's weight category. Light and Medium melee weapons can be held in two hands for +1d6 damage. A Heavy weapon held one-handed costs 15% to hitting and 10% to Defense, and blocks Doctrine and Specialization actions.
WeaponInfo.dmgType: The damage types the attack uses. A "+" listing means the attack uses every type at once; a "/" listing favours the attacker. Vulnerability, Resistance and Immunity are resolved against these types.

AbsorbBlood.name: Blood Absorption
AbsorbBlood.description: Cancel your entire Blood Reserve and heal Life equal to your Maximum Transfer. You cannot heal more Life than you cancelled from the Reserve.
AbsorbBlood.result: Burned {discarded} from the Blood Reserve and healed {healed} Life.

BloodPact.name: Blood Pact
BloodPact.description:
Once per round you may burn one of your Mind points to immediately gain Life into your Blood Reserve equal to your Maximum Transfer.

A burned Mind point is lost permanently: both your current Mind and your maximum Mind drop by one. Only a ritual or a potion can restore it.
BloodPact.result: Burned a Mind point ({mindValue}/{mindMax} left) and gained {gained} into the Blood Reserve.
BloodPact.alreadyUsed: Blood Pact has already been used this round.
BloodPact.noMind: No Mind point left to burn.
BloodPact.reserveFull: The Blood Reserve has no room left.

DreamDew.name: Dream dew
DreamDew.description:
Effect - Advanced base
Duration - 12 hours
Toxicity - 20
Production bonus - +10% -> 2 doses
Ingredients - Strong alcohol, Pa, Al, Ve

A brewed alchemical base. One dose replaces one use of Distillate in any recipe that calls for it. The dew keeps for 12 hours after brewing; what is left over after that is spoiled. Drinking it is worth nothing but its 20 toxicity.

RecipeDreamDew.name: Recipe: Dream dew
RecipeDreamDew.description:
Effect - Advanced base
Duration - 12 hours
Toxicity - 20
Production bonus - +10% -> 2 doses
Ingredients - Strong alcohol, Pa, Al, Ve

A brewed alchemical base. One dose replaces one use of Distillate in any recipe that calls for it. The dew keeps for 12 hours after brewing; what is left over after that is spoiled. Drinking it is worth nothing but its 20 toxicity.

FastReaction.name: Fast Reaction
FastReaction.description:
You throw yourself into the next exchange a beat ahead of everyone else. Gain +4 Initiative until the start of your next turn, which means the bonus is still with you when turn order is rolled again at the top of the next round.

Cumulative: spend the action twice in the same round and the bonus is +8. Your Initiative is still capped at 15.
FastReaction.capped: Initiative is already at its cap, so part of the bonus was lost.

FuscinaIctus.name: Fuscina Ictus
FuscinaIctus.description:
Modifies Attack, Counterattack, Opportunity Attack, Multiattack, Exploit Weakness, Reckless strike and Charge. Cost applies to each attack.

Bleeding chance +120%.

Cannot be combined with Trip. Trident only.

FuscinaIctusFeature.name: Fuscina Ictus
FuscinaIctusFeature.description: Grants the Fuscina Ictus action. While attacking with a trident you may spend 3 Stamina per attack to raise the Bleeding chance by 120%.

StarsignAdventurer.name: Starsign: Adventurer
StarsignAdventurer.description: Traps +5%, Advantage on saving throws against traps and on Perception against ambushes.

StarsignMage.name: Starsign: Mage
StarsignMage.description:
If they have no magic potential, they gain Limited magic potential. If they have Limited magic potential, they gain Magic potential. Mana base +1 and Channeling +5%

If they cannot have magic potential, they reroll.

StarsignScholar.name: Starsign: Scholar
StarsignScholar.description:
Logic +10%, may reroll a Logic roll once per day. Shortens learning by 1 or 5 days.

If they have the Illiterate trait, they reroll.

StarsignDruid.name: Starsign: Druid
StarsignDruid.description:
Animal handling +10%, may reroll an Animal handling roll once per day. May cast the spell Speak with Animals once per day for free.

If they cannot have magic potential, they reroll.

StarsignHearth.name: Starsign: Hearth
StarsignHearth.description:
Fire resistance +25%, may cast the spell Sparks once per day for free.

If they cannot have magic potential, they reroll.

StarsignCat.name: Starsign: Cat
StarsignCat.description:
Acrobatics +5%, may cast the spell Feather Fall once per day for free.

If they cannot have magic potential, they reroll.

StarsignTower.name: Starsign: Tower
StarsignTower.description:
Insight +5%, may cast the spell Telepathy once per day for free.

If they cannot have magic potential, they reroll.

StarsignAlchemist.name: Starsign: Alchemist
StarsignAlchemist.description: Alchemy +5%, chance of a Critical Failure in Alchemy -1%

StarsignLovers.name: Starsign: Lovers
StarsignLovers.description: Appearance +1, may reroll a Temptation roll once per day

StarsignRock.name: Starsign: Rock
StarsignRock.description: Health +5. A Long Rest restores 2 more health.

StarsignSmith.name: Starsign: Smith
StarsignSmith.description: Smithing +5%, may reroll a Smithing roll once per day.

StarsignShadow.name: Starsign: Shadow
StarsignShadow.description: May turn invisible once per day for one minute. Does not extend to equipment or clothing. Stealth +5%

StarsignNorthStar.name: Starsign: North Star
StarsignNorthStar.description: Always senses where north is and can roughly tell the part of the day, regardless of location. May spend 10 actions asking their Star for the right direction, 25% chance

StarsignOwl.name: Starsign: Owl
StarsignOwl.description:
Better eyesight in the dark. In absolute darkness sees up to 3m as if in dim light, in darkness sees as if in dim light, and in dim light sees without penalty.

Does not stack with the Child of the Night trait or with the Rune Warrior.

StarsignAcrobat.name: Starsign: Acrobat
StarsignAcrobat.description: Acrobatics +5%, may reroll an Acrobatics roll once per day

StarsignHorse.name: Starsign: Horse
StarsignHorse.description: Horse handling +25%, limited ability to communicate with horses.

StarsignDog.name: Starsign: Dog
StarsignDog.description: Always knows whether something is poisoned with a natural or alchemical poison. For magical poisons, 50% chance

StarsignHeart.name: Starsign: Heart
StarsignHeart.description:
May transform into their animal once per day. The animal is chosen by a die roll. The animal cannot speak, equipment stays behind. 90% chance to transform, 75% chance to transform back, one attempt per day.

A Critical Failure means an automatic failure for the next two days.

  1. Pig
  2. Frog
  3. Squirrel
  4. Dog
  5. Crow
  6. Cat
  7. Stag
  8. Snake
  9. Wolf
  10. Horse
  11. Hawk
  12. Bear

StarsignMirror.name: Starsign: Mirror
StarsignMirror.description:
20% chance to deflect a spell in a random direction.

Applies only to targeted hits, including healing and similar "non-projectile" effects. A fireball that explodes nearby is not affected.

StarsignDevil.name: Starsign: Devil
StarsignDevil.description: May hold up to 3 souls within. 25% chance to trap the soul of someone who died nearby, which triggers a Resolve Test to gain a point of insanity. Insanity threshold -1. If capacity is full, the soul is replaced.

StarsignAtronach.name: Starsign: Atronach
StarsignAtronach.description:
Ignores 50% of magic damage and converts it into mana. Excess mana burns off at the end of the next turn and deals 2 damage for every mage burned within 1.5m. The damage is dealt to itself as well. Mana base +5. Mana regeneration -50%

If they have neither Limited magic potential nor Magic potential, they reroll.

StarsignHen.name: Starsign: Hen
StarsignHen.description: A tendency to get lost and always stray off course.

StarsignButterfly.name: Starsign: Butterfly
StarsignButterfly.description: 20% chance to be Stunned when hit by magic.

StarsignBat.name: Starsign: Bat
StarsignBat.description: Vulnerability to fire, takes 50% more damage. When exposed to sunlight, takes a -5% penalty to Success

StarsignDice.name: Starsign: Dice
StarsignDice.description: Luck -1, Gambling -15%, the urge to gamble triggers a Resolve Test (Easy); on a failure they are compelled to play until they beat an Advanced Resolve Test or are forced to stop.

StarsignFairy.name: Starsign: Fairy
StarsignFairy.description: Senses magic within 50m. On close contact with magic, takes a -5% penalty to Success for 1 hour. A spellcaster has Disadvantage on Channeling.

StarsignDeadEye.name: Starsign: Dead Eye
StarsignDeadEye.description: Gains one Insanity. Insanity threshold -1. The effect of this Star cannot be changed.

StarsignSnake.name: Starsign: Snake
StarsignSnake.description: Gains one Curse. The effect of this Star cannot be changed.

StarsignFireEye.name: Starsign: Fire Eye
StarsignFireEye.description: The soul is marked by Sheol. At the moment of death, unless directly prevented, the soul is taken to Sheol, which makes resurrection impossible. The effect of this Star cannot be changed.

Wimp.name: Wimp
Wimp.description: However the dice fall, this creature can never land a critical hit above the second degree. Its crit range is rolled in full — only the degree it buckets into is capped.

Rations.name: Rations
Rations.description: A day's worth of trail food: hard bread, dried meat, whatever the pot gave up. One unit feeds one mouth for a third of a day. A normal character eats 3 units per Long Rest.

Currency.Title: Currency roster
Currency.MenuHint: Define the coin denominations and the standard prices every character sheet uses.
Currency.DenominationsHint: Keys are internal and never shown to players (c1, c2, s1...). Rename the labels freely; renaming never touches anyone's purse. Value is in base units and the lowest rung must be 1.
Currency.PricesHint: Standard costs in base units. The readout shows what that comes to in coins.
Currency.BaseWarning: The lowest denomination is not worth 1. Prices that fall below it cannot be represented and will be rounded away.
Currency.NumericKey: Denomination keys cannot be numbers ({keys}). Use a short word like c1 or copper.
Currency.DuplicateKey: Two denominations share the key "{key}". Each one needs its own.
